masks.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: grayscale foil coverage mask for a real-time card shader. Convert the supplied Ninetales card to a perfectly registered grayscale foil mask, same portrait composition and framing, preserving all silhouette positions. This is a data texture, NOT a finished card image. On pure black: fine elegant white-to-gray engraved flowing lines following the nine tails, white specks in the sunny leaf canopy, soft medium gray regions of warm sunlight, delicate gold-leaf-like flecks but entirely grayscale. Ninetales body mostly dark charcoal with bright fine contours, forest trunks mostly black, printed text and icons and all borders solid black so text remains readable under foil. Use varied 0-255 grays for strength, tiny bright etched details, flowing organic guilloche engraving. No new text, no colors, no perspective, no surrounding space. Output only the aligned full card mask, opaque black background.

stars: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless grayscale foil mask texture for a GPU shader. Square flat texture of tiny elegant four-point stars, sparse six-point stars, fine glitter pinpoints and very small diamond-like crystalline facets on pure black. Crisp micro-engraved collectible trading card holographic star foil pattern. White = strongest, lots of medium gray and dim gray stars, soft falloffs, mostly black negative space. No color, no letters, no card, no borders, no object silhouette, no lighting or vignette across the canvas. Evenly distributed, truly tileable on all edges. Fine intricate detail, stars vary in size from tiny specks to a few medium starbursts. This is a data texture, not a metallic rendering.
